rows.scene: Contrast the three qualities using three quiet mineral-color zones: a clear lotus rising above still water, a balanced field of motion and a dark heavy earth band. A single small lotus at the transition suggests devotion beyond the qualities. No people or deity portraits. Use firm dark contours, opaque matte mineral colors and shallow decorative space in the series palette: earth ochre, deep maroon, warm cream, muted olive and reserved deep indigo-blue for divine skin.

rows.commentary: The world’s knowledge, faith, actions, dwellings, joys, and foods differ through the three qualities. What is centered on You and Your service is described as established beyond those qualities; by worshipping You, may I quickly attain that state.

Keep the cues simple and nonjudgmental: no person is singled out as inferior, and the same soft mural motif recurs in each area to convey the Lord in every being. Use firm dark contours, opaque matte mineral colors and shallow decorative space in the series palette: earth ochre, deep maroon, warm cream, muted olive and reserved deep indigo-blue for divine skin.

rows.commentary: While Your presence is not yet clearly seen in all things, let me worship in this way; through the insight of oneness may I become filled with You and move through life accordingly. Since this path of devotion is not to be abandoned, Lord, grant me the beautiful way of devotion with all my being.

The sage is reverent but declines offered boons with a composed gesture; his gaze asks to witness the Lord's māyā. Three figures only, clearly separated.
